title: Instacart Contrast
slide_intent: Show how stroke contrast changes the voice of a large headline. Comparing specimens lets designers judge how much emphasis a particular occasion needs.
strategic_value: Instacart can express appetite with a more modulated face while retaining optical sizes for smaller headlines.
demonstration: Four increasingly heavy versions of Deliciously form a display column. Each is paired with uppercase, lowercase and numeral samples on the right.
practical_value: Choose a headline treatment by inspecting how much the strokes vary and how legible the smaller forms remain at the intended size.

content_islands.name: Face description
content_islands.spec: Place the Instacart Contrast heading and its explanation of expressive and smaller headline uses in the left column.

content_islands.name: Display range
content_islands.spec: Keep the large word consistent across four specimens and align an alphabet block with each. Leave the page ground white.
